candidates.change_summary: Removed the require(msg.sender == Owner) check so any address can withdraw the contract's balance.
Removed the transfer statement so withdraw() no longer sends the contract balance to the owner.
Replaced the transferred amount address(this).balance with 1 so only 1 wei is sent to the owner instead of the full balance.
Remove the owner-only require check so any address can execute Command.
Negate the ownership check so Command succeeds only for non-owner callers.
Call the target address with zero value instead of the attached msg.value.
Change the if condition to `msg.value > 0`, so transfers also happen when the previously required balance threshold is not met.
Transfer only the pre-existing balance instead of balance plus msg.value.
Delete the transfer statement so no Ether is sent to adr.
Send the funds to the Owner instead of the adr parameter.
Transfer only msg.value instead of the whole balance plus msg.value.
